text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Listen to my beautiful voice!<n>I've fully
recovered from that curse<n>brought upon me by that
super spicy<n>death sauce!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Dober, my rival at the upcoming<n>Shuka Sho, is in the
audience<n>watching me today. I'll show her just<n>how
well I can run!
